svg.title: The guarantees stop at the tested boundary
svg.desc: The local profiles are deliberately bounded: 256 events per episode, pages/pending batches of sixteen, 32 observations per belief, at most 64 support records, and three CAS retries per drain. Owner history is retained without garbage collection or a total disk quota. Authority is a development local policy, not production identity management. Explicit model semantics and exact runtime selection are required. Native caller evidence is for the chosen Programs route and selected tests, not the full Hive suite, LLM operation or arbitrary application behavior. Future Relations/Search, ECAN, inference control and general PLN rules remain outside implemented scope. Chain and live migration are unrun. No new runtime guarantee is created by rebuilding this presentation.
svg.text: 04 / LIMITS AND STOPPING POINT
